messages.subject: Public affairs and low-carbon metals | Executive introduction from Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Rasi,

Your public-affairs remit at Outokumpu sits directly at the intersection of industrial policy, low-carbon metals, regulation and stakeholder engagement. Those priorities align closely with the country-facing and ESG work I lead today inside a major mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement, coordinate regulatory and stakeholder matters across operating functions, and translate external expectations into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating records.

I am exploring senior international roles where this combination of public affairs, government relations, sustainability and operator-side industrial experience could support policy engagement and long-term growth. Outokumpu's low-carbon metals agenda is particularly relevant to that background.

I would value a conversation about where my experience might support your public-affairs or broader strategic stakeholder agenda. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Outokumpu.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
